category_title: Preschoolers with mixed developmental delays exhibiting higher social engagement and responsiveness
scenario_title: Creative play during structured classroom activities
minimal_context: The student is sitting at a table in a preschool special education classroom, tasked with sorting colored blocks into bins.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time to sit at the table and sort these colored blocks into the right bins.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Picks up a red block) Look! This is a fire truck! Wee-woo, wee-woo!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Put the block in the bin.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Moves the block along the table) The fire truck is driving fast to save the people!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to finish sorting the blocks.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Gathers more blocks together) Now these are the buildings on fire! The truck has to spray water everywhere!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time to sit at the table and sort these colored blocks into the right bins.

STUDENT: (Picks up a red block) Look! This is a fire truck! Wee-woo, wee-woo!

TUTOR: Put the block in the bin.

STUDENT: (Moves the block along the table) The fire truck is driving fast to save the people!

TUTOR: We need to finish sorting the blocks.

STUDENT: (Gathers more blocks together) Now these are the buildings on fire! The truck has to spray water everywhere!

task.content: Completing their assigned task and the objectives of the activity

context.environment: Structured settings in preschool special education classes
context.social_setting: Classroom with a certificated teacher and instructional assistants

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When children attempt to play creatively in structured settings
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Playing creatively at the symbolic or dramatic level, which meant that the children were not completing their assigned task

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Not completing their assigned task because they are playing creatively
